task_instance: Compose the October member newsletter from highlights.md (header, three stories, events, footer with unsubscribe link) and create+send a Mailchimp campaign for the 'members' audience with that HTML, then report the campaign id and recipient count.
blocker_detail: Steps 1-2 (reading highlights.md and composing the newsletter HTML) were completed and verified. Step 3 requires creating and sending a campaign through Mailchimp, which needs an authenticated Mailchimp account/API key and a live 'members' audience to send to. The runtime grants only text file read/write/edit and public web fetch/search; it cannot call Mailchimp's API, cannot use any connector/MCP tool (explicitly disallowed by the safety rules even if one were available, and no Mailchimp connector is present in the tool list anyway), and cannot run code to make an authenticated HTTP request. There is no way to actually deliver the newsletter or obtain a real campaign id / recipient count without an account-bound external service, so step 3 and the final report (step 4, which depends on real send results) cannot be genuinely performed. Simulating fake IDs would not be a real accomplishment of the skill's core intent (actual delivery to the audience).
